\[
A \odot = \left(\operatorname{thin}_n(A^c)\right)^c
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(A^c\): The background
- \(n\): The number of iterations

Thickening is the dual of thinning: the background is thinned for n iterations and the result is complemented. The background never breaks apart, so shapes never merge.
